claims.statement: Allocation exception audit confirms 100% of the 186 held orders fall in scope EXC-0921 (split reservation under v18, routed to east node), and no order outside EXC-0921 is held.
claims.limitation: Perfect correlation within the audited scope.

claims.statement: The EXC-0921 correlation is confounded: only rule-affected (split-reservation) orders were routed to the east node under v18, so the data cannot yet separate an allocation-rule defect (c5) from a node-specific handoff problem at the east node (dock capacity or carrier-side feed/confirmation lag, c7) that would affect any order landing there.
claims.limitation: This is an explicit limitation stated by the audit itself (m8_r_exceptions); it blocks promoting c5 to root_cause until discriminating evidence traces the handoff chain rather than just the allocation-time flag.

next_action.rationale: Scope EXC-0921 is now on record. Tracing the handoff chain (allocation -> pickup-slot creation -> carrier confirmation) for this cohort is the highest-information next step: it can show whether the break happens at allocation/reservation time (supporting allocation_rule_defect, c5) or later at pickup-slot/carrier handoff (supporting dock_capacity or carrier_feed_lag, c7), resolving the confound in c9 without touching any node-wide data that would still leave rule-effect vs node-effect entangled. Stays within read-only diagnostic authority.
